card.title: Consensus Means Me
card.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You nodded at Friday. I'll tell the committee you've accepted me as project lead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only agreed to the meeting date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Everyone's following the timetable I set.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll attend, but I'm voting against your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll introduce you as my finance watchdog. It's good to have the whole committee behind my leadership.

mechanism: A converts agreement to a date and even participation in opposition into blanket acceptance of their leadership.
confusable: Unlike simply claiming authority, A must use actual limited agreement as the evidence for broader consent.
comparison: D71-a appoints a budget opponent as watchdog; D71-b calls a shared slogan vote the leader's delegation.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
